She skillfully tosses a drumstick high into the air and catches it without breaking her rhythm. (2) As the performance continues, she plays with extreme energy and precision. She is seen headbanging, her hair flying across her face, and her mouth open in a shout of excitement. The background features several onlookers, including a small child being held by an adult. The lighting is bright and overhead, casting a clean studio-like glow over the drum kit, which features copper-colored cymbals. (3) Throughout the drumming, she maintains intense facial expressions, alternating between focused concentration and joyful smiles. The camera remains static, capturing her upper body and the top half of the drum kit. In the background, retail store windows and passers-by provide a bustling urban context. (4) The sequence concludes with her finishing a drum fill and looking up with a broad, genuine smile, showing her teeth and squinting her eyes in happiness as the performance ends.
